{{Youmay|The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Minister of Justice|other uses of [[Minister of Justice (disambiguation)]]}}
The '''Minister of Justice''' was a position in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] government. The minister was one of the key members of the [[General Ministry]] and the various ruling councils, always being the fourth most powerful member, under the [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]], [[Minister of State]], and [[Supreme Commander (Alliance)/Legends|Supreme Commander]]. Should the Minister of State have to take over for a Chief of State, the minister of justice would assume the duties associated with the Minister of State.

The minister of justice and the chair of the Senate [[Justice Council]] were similar positions. The minister of justice position was established with the dissolution of the [[New Republic Provisional Council|Provisional Council]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]]-[[11 ABY/Legends|11 ABY]]. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the [[Ruling Council]] was created, and the chair of the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|Senate Justice Council]] took over the duties of minister of justice. The position of minister of justice was reestablished in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] with the beginning of the tenure of [[Ponc Gavrisom]]. The Senate regained the powers with the tenure of [[Borsk Fey'lya]] beginning in [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]].
